text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black won't let anyone near!
Avenge last year's defeat, and let the Kitasan Festival begin again today!
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about a commanding presence!
You've gotten even stronger, Kitasan Black!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Proof that the skills of the Umamusume of the Year
are alive and well again this year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's got plenty of room to grow, too.
She's not gonna just take this loss lying down.
We definitely can't take our eyes off Kitasan vs. Satono going forward!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, both Kita-chan and Dia-chan
have grown up so splendidly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From whose perspective are you speaking...?
Though, I do agree.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them race
kind of reminded me of our head-to-head match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring), isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... the next race for those two as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so~.
...By the way, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm in a reeeeeeally, really big mood
to run right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence.
I am as well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wanna run all the way back to the station?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
ALLLRIIIGHT!!
I took the Osaka Hai! That's number one in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(As I thought, her strength is on a whole different level
compared to when Kita-chan ran the Arima Kinen...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I had caught up to Kita-chan in terms of running,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Kita-chan has gotten leaps and bounds stronger!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Just when I thought I was catching up.
They pulled away again...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Because I worked desperately hard not to lose to Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Feel Dia-chan's strength
at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought I gave it my all,
but it wasn't nearly enough, was it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still! In that case, I'll work even harder!
Next time, I'm definitely going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's race again, Dia-chan!
I want to run with you even more!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because my desire to beat Dia-chan
is what makes me stronger!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)!!
I want Dia-chan to run in it too!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)...
That's the race where Kita-chan's back-to-back victory is on the line, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want to run the longest GⅠ,
the 3,200m, together with Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Talk it over with your Trainer and think about it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting in Kyoto!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, about the next race...
choice_data_list: It's the Tenno Sho (Spring), isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...But why?

Satono Diamond said that while chasing after
Kitasan Black, she wants to ponder
what it truly means to be a "legendary Umamusume."

Therefore, I had anticipated entering
the races that Kitasan Black is aiming for.

Besides, I figured Satono Diamond would intentionally
challenge Kitasan Black in the Tenno Sho (Spring)—
a race where Kitasan excels and is aiming for consecutive wins.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you see right through everything.
...Hm, then it seems there should be no problem with me making on-the-spot decisions from now on.
choice_data_list: No, at least consult me first?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Today's defeat made me realize that I lack the strength to ever be called a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This time, I must defeat Kita-chan in the Tenno Sho (Spring)...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And I shall bring home the historic Shield,
along with its glory, to House Satono.
